name: Snake Transformer Studio
description: Design and simulate PCB snake-winding matrix transformers.
description_full:
Snake Transformer Studio is a focused workspace for snake-winding matrix transformers. Configure a ferrite pillar grid, mirrored PCB winding pairs, stackup and operating point; inspect geometry, magnetic-network estimates, winding losses and parameter sweeps; then export editable KiCad PCBs and project files.

Run locally in a browser with Python alone, or launch from KiCad through its IPC plugin interface. The native window is optional. KiCad board placement verifies layers and named nets before changing the board; complete PCB export includes core openings. Analytical estimates expose their assumptions and require validation before hardware use.

Built on Planar Studio, licensed MIT. This is a development release, not a hardware-qualified design package.
